title: BYD Throne, Dominating Global Electric Vehicles
paragraphs: BYD controls 22.2 percent of the global market share for electric vehicle sales. Next, Tesla 10.3 percent and Wuling 4 percent.

Chinese electric car manufacturer BYD has taken the top spot as the world's pure electric car or battery electric vehicle (BEV). BYD far surpasses its competitors, such as Tesla, Wuling, MBW, Volkswagen, and Mercedes-Benz.

The first order or the one that dominates the global market share is the BYD brand with a total of 3.84 million vehicles, both BEV and PHEV electric vehicles. BYD controls 22.2 percent of all electric vehicle sales in the global market or up 1.2 percentage points from 2023.

The second place is occupied by the American brand, Tesla, which managed to sell 1.78 million units or control 10.3 percent of the market share. Tesla's global market share fell 1.2 percent year-on-year (yoy). In 2023, Tesla's market share reached 13.2 percent.
In the first two months of 2025, BYD has sold about 130,000 of its electric vehicles.

The US's largest BEV maker, Tesla, has had a tough start to the year, with January sales down 47 percent in Europe and 15 percent in China. Tesla's sales in France, Germany, the UK and Belgium fell 63 percent.
Based on data from the European Automobile Manufacturers Association (ACEA), Tesla's sales in January 2025 were only 9,945 vehicles.
BYD's dominance of the global market share is also seen in Indonesia. In total, electric car sales throughout 2024 rose 161 percent compared to the previous year in 2023.

In 2025, electric vehicles in Indonesia continue to grow. Most recently, in February 2025, Gaikindo recorded a total of 7,659 sales units (wholesales). BYD still recorded the highest sales in Indonesia at 2,513 units.
